title: Evaluating Monolingual and Multilingual Large Language Models for Greek Question Answering: The DemosQA Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the zero-shot and few-shot accuracy of monolingual (Greek-adapted) large language models against multilingual models across multiple Greek question-answering benchmarks to highlight performance disparities stemming from training data imbalances favoring high-resource languages.

Evaluating model accuracy on a natively constructed, community-reviewed Greek QA dataset (DemosQA) sourced from social media to assess how well models capture local Greek social and cultural nuances, contrasting this with their performance on translated, English-centric datasets.
